what: Alamos Gold mines gold in Canada and Mexico, with its main operations at Island Gold and Young-Davidson in Ontario and Mulatos in Mexico.
customers: Refiners and bullion markets; gold sells at a world price.
money: an underground and open pit complex in Ontario
open pit heap leach operations in Mexico
moat: Long-life mines in Canada, a jurisdiction with stable permitting, and among the lowest production costs in the industry.
risks: Earnings follow the gold price, which the company does not control
Free cash flow of $180M is modest because the Island Gold expansion is still being built
Only three analysts cover the stock
opportunities: 10.3 times earnings with a 49.0% net margin, among the highest in gold mining
Revenue grew from $824M to $1.8B in four years
Analysts see about 50% upside, and the Island Gold expansion raises output while cutting cost per ounce
watch: All-in sustaining cost per ounce and the Island Gold expansion schedule.
